title: Special Weather Statement by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
1 hours ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-05-20 22:21:00 CDT Expires: 2026-05-20 23:15:00 CDT Urgency: Expected Severity: Moderate Certainty: Observed Instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building. Target Area: Sutton; Kimble; Mason At 1021 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over Roosevelt, moving east at 35 mph.
HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is possible.
Locations impacted include... Junction, Yates Crossing, London, Segovia, South Llano River State Park, Roosevelt, Cleo, and I-10 Near The Sutton-Kimble County Line.
This includes Interstate 10 between Mile Markers 432 and 465.
